conventions.timezone: All times are Asia/Dhaka local, 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'. 26 Oct 2026 is a Monday.
conventions.workweek: Bangladesh workweek is Sunday-Thursday, so 'this week' from Monday 26 Oct means by Thursday 29 Oct.
conventions.phone_call_notes: Call notes are written by staff in English, so language is 'english', but the reply should be a call script, not a text message.
conventions.scoring: Strict match: message_type, interest, language, status. Priority counts as correct if within one level. follow_up_by: date must match. Flags: scored as recall of the expected flags. name: case-insensitive match. Free-text fields (reasons, summary, detail) are not scored.
conventions.do_not_leak: Never paste these 20 items into the prompt as examples. The prompt uses invented examples only, otherwise the eval score means nothing.
